slides.headline: STARSHIP WENT FROM BLOWING UP TO MAKING MONEY

caption:
Starship just flew its first paid mission, and your internet might get faster because of it. 🚀

On September 28, 2026, Starship reached orbit and deployed V3 Starlink satellites, completing SpaceX's first ever revenue-generating Starship flight. V3 Starlinks are a new generation that Starship is the only rocket big enough to carry, opening a lane Falcon 9 can't touch. If you use Starlink, your service just got its first V3 upgrade. The rocket that went viral for exploding just quietly earned its first paycheck.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what shifts like this mean for yours.

Sources: Sawyer Merritt on X
